name: Strategy Pack
description:
Two read-only Claude Code subagents designed for solo founders and small
teams whose strategy lives in distributed markdown docs.

**/business-critic** — daily devil's-advocate. Reads your BUSINESS.md,
ROADMAP.md, and recent session log; does live web search for competitor
moves and industry news; produces a critique where every doubt cites a
URL or a falsifiable experiment. Rotates through seven critique
dimensions (positioning, activation gates, monetization, competitive
substitution, GTM, founder reality, strategic drift), going deep on
three or four per run. No cheerleading.

**/pm** — weekly cross-document alignment auditor. Scans BUSINESS.md,
ROADMAP.md, every backlog (todo-*.md / BACKLOG-*.md), in-flight plan
files, API contract docs, and git log. Flags orphaned commitments
("ROADMAP promised X, no owning task"), blocked-by mismatches across
domains, stale plans, and API doc lag. Drafts follow-up plan stubs
without ever editing your docs.

Both agents are strictly read-only — they produce reports you act on.
Pair them: daily critic for external skepticism, weekly auditor for
internal coordination.
longDescription:
Ships **3 agents** and **4 commands**.

- **Agents** (3): `business-critic` (Devil's-advocate reviewer for your business plan that always opens a draft PR with its findings), `pm` (Apply-mode doc reconciler), `product-advisor` (READ-ONLY cross-domain alignment advisor)
- **Commands** (4): `align` (Full alignment cycle in one run — diagnoses with product-advisor (read-only), then applies with pm (edits the TODO/backlog),…), `business-critic` (Run the business-critic subagent — devil's-advocate pass over your business plan vs current market reality), `pm` (Run the pm subagent — apply-mode doc reconciler), `product-advisor` (Run the product-advisor subagent — read-only cross-domain alignment advice across strategy / roadmap / per-domain backlogs / plans…)

Installs with `claude plugin install strategy-pack@claude-community` from `kyoon3/claude-strategy-pack`.
